instruction: A candid, clean studio photograph in a medium shot showing two women playing a hand-clapping game against a plain beige backdrop. On the left, the woman with short brown hair (R2) in a striped shirt and beige pants sits facing right, smiling. On the right, the woman with dark curly afro hair (R1) in a purple long-sleeve shirt sits facing left, smiling. They look at each other as the woman with short brown hair's left hand touches the woman with dark curly afro hair's right hand, while the woman with dark curly afro hair's left hand is held near her chest. The scene is illuminated by soft, even studio lighting with a warm, neutral color palette.
